pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit high edge angularity with sharp, serrated pixel gradients. Geometry consists of irregular polygons, larger on the neck and reducing in spatial area toward the shoulder and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Features numerous tri-point junction nodes. Pathways maintain a narrow and relatively consistent pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two small avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge and mid-neck, causing localized occlusion of the underlying pelage and mane geometry.
